examples.title: Library with an impossible upper room

subject.description: A public library with books, reading desks, and three reading levels.
subject.meaning_to_preserve: Welcoming civic access to reading spaces and one deliberate contradiction in access to knowledge.

examples.medium: Black-and-ivory woodcut-style print for a portrait poster.
examples.composition: A central Romanesque nave has rounded arches and heavy piers. One side stair reaches two incompatible upper rooms while the ground-floor desks remain spatially coherent. A narrow folded triangular surface crosses the upper-right vault. Project parallel lines across it: spacing compresses with foreshortening, direction changes at folds, and piers occlude the lines.

examples.optics: None; use carved lines rather than photographic blur or lens effects.

examples.title: A quiet garden crossing

subject.description: A narrow moonlit garden path crossing a shallow stone-lined stream.
subject.meaning_to_preserve: A calm garden encounter with a path continuing beyond the visible focal plane.

examples.medium: Photographic-style landscape image for a website's introductory panel.
examples.composition: The wet foreground stepping stone is crisp, while the garden behind it recedes into mist. Leave a darker quiet region on the left for separate live website text. Show a small patch of lichen on the stone edge.
examples.palette: Midnight #101C2B, silver-ivory #EEF0F6, restrained teal #8AD9CE; one lavender #C5B8DE reflection, with pink and gold omitted in this brief.
examples.optics: Shallow depth of field centered on the stone; a modest horizontal anamorphic highlight from reflected moonlight; refraction only in visible water droplets and along the shallow water surface.
examples.abstraction: An unseen garden is conveyed by partially occluded distances and a path continuing beyond the focal plane, without symbolic decorations.
